Cama and Albless Hospital (also called Pestonji Cama & Albless Hospital) is a long-established government hospital in Mumbai that specialises in healthcare for women and children. It is one of the city’s key public referral centres in these areas and operates under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC).

Location
Address: Mahapalika Marg, opposite Azad Maidan, Dhobi Talao, near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Fort, Mumbai 400001, Maharashtra, India.

The hospital is centrally located and easily accessible by train, bus and taxi from across the city.

History & Capacity
The hospital was founded in 1886, making it one of Mumbai’s oldest public healthcare institutions.

It originally started as Cama Hospital and was later renamed Cama and Albless Hospital.

Current bed capacity is around 500+ beds dedicated to women’s and children’s care.

Primary Focus and Services
Healthcare for Women and Children:

Maternity care, high-risk pregnancies and obstetrics

Gynaecology including specialised clinics such as urogynaecology
Paediatric care and neonatal services

Low-cost or subsidised treatment as a public hospital for eligible patients

Oncology and Advanced Care:
The hospital runs an oncology wing with chemotherapy and related services focused on cancers common in women.

Radiation therapy services have been modernised with a linear accelerator machine to provide targeted treatment free of charge for cancer patients, a significant upgrade in public cancer care.

Reproductive Health and ART:
The hospital offers assisted reproductive technology (ART) services, including IVF. Since May 2024 these services have been made available free of cost under the state health insurance scheme for eligible patients, making it the first public hospital in Maharashtra to do so.

In late 2025 it became the first public hospital in the state authorised to provide egg freezing and sperm bank services as part of its ART programme.

Other Developments:
The hospital is adding educational programs such as a postgraduate diploma in oncology nursing to support cancer care training.

A Centre of Excellence for Women’s Pelvic Health has opened to treat urogynaecological conditions, with modern diagnostics and clinic rooms.

Teaching & Referral Role
Cama and Albless Hospital also functions as a teaching and research hospital linked with Grant Medical College and is part of a network of public hospitals that train doctors and healthcare professionals.

Community Role

It serves a wide patient base from Mumbai and nearby districts, offering emergency care 24/7 and referral services for specialised women’s and children’s health needs at subsidised costs.

Not every normal delivery progresses smoothly till the end. In some cases, labour advances well but the baby does not deliver despite good contractions. When the cervix is fully open and the baby’s head is already low, vacuum assisted delivery may be used to help complete the birth safely. This is a form of assisted delivery used only under specific conditions.

During vacuum delivery, a suction cup is attached to the baby’s head and gentle assistance is given while the mother pushes with contractions. This helps reduce prolonged strain during the second stage of labour and allows timely delivery when support is needed.

At Pradnya Maternity IVF and Multispeciality Hospital in Mulund, Dr Pradnya Randive manages labour and delivery with careful assessment at every stage. The focus is on safe normal delivery, early identification of delivery delays, and using assisted methods only when they are medically appropriate for the mother and baby.

Heavy Periods & Painful Periods Should Not Be Ignored

Many women experience heavy bleeding during periods, severe cramps, or both, and assume it is normal. However, when periods last more than 7 days, involve passing large clots, or require frequent pad changes, this condition is called menorrhagia. When periods are extremely painful and interfere with daily activities, it is known as dysmenorrhea.

According to Dr. Pradnya Randive, Obstetrician Gynaecologist and Fertility Specialist at Pradnya Maternity IVF & Multispeciality Hospital, Mulund, these symptoms often have underlying medical causes such as fibroids, endometriosis, pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), or thyroid-related problems. Ignoring them can lead to anaemia, fertility issues, and long-term health complications.

Early consultation with a gynaecologist helps identify the cause through basic evaluations such as blood tests and pelvic sonography, allowing timely and effective treatment. Not all heavy or painful periods require surgery, but they do require proper medical assessment.

At Pradnya Maternity IVF & Multispeciality Hospital, women receive personalised care for menstrual problems, pregnancy, and normal delivery, with a focus on accurate diagnosis and safe treatment.

If you are facing heavy bleeding, painful periods, or irregular cycles, consult a gynaecologist early and avoid self-medication.

featured_reviews.name: PSM
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had our second baby at Fortis Hospital Mulund's NEST department.

No matter how much you plan, some things are just out of your control - While we hoped for a normal delivery, we ended up needing a C-section.

The medical care was excellent and we felt completely safe.

Dr. Sangeeta Raodeo was fantastic - always calm, clear with her explanations, and available whenever we called during pregnancy. She guided us through everything and gave us confidence during delivery.

The hospital staff was genuinely helpful. The nurses (especially the night shift), cleaning crew, food team, and even security on a few occasions helped us with our requests. The hospital itself was clean and well-organized.

However, the billing department on the 9th floor was a nightmare. The staff seemed completely unprofessional and deliberately made patients wait unnecessarily for running bills. On discharge day, they basically harass you and will overcharge by at least 10%-15% if you're not extremely vigilant. The accounts team won't listen to complaints or help resolve issues.

Thankfully, Dr. Raodeo stepped in to help us sort out the billing mess - she's truly a gem! We were eventually able to meet the billing head directly to resolve things.

Once again, special thanks to Dr. Sangeeta Raodeo, and the NEST team for excellent medical care. Just be very careful with billing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Swara Matkar from Kanjurmarg. Doctor Aparna Madam and Shreyas Sir are no less than God for me. They both are very supportive. I got motherhood only because of them. After seven years, my first pregnancy became possible through IVF. In the 3rd month, when my baby was in the womb, they performed an operation to get rid of all the problems and brought my baby into this world safely. I got a son only because of the efforts of these two aparna madam and shreyas sir.
Now my son is 3.5 years old. After 3 years, I got pregnant normally again. At that time, I was also a diabetic patient and Aparna madam took proper care of me and brought my second son safely into this world. Yesterday, it was 12 days since my baby was born. I will always be grateful for the care that Aparna madam and the entire staff of her hospital took during this difficult time. Nurse Mavshi also took great care of me. Aparna madam and Shreyas Sir, thank you very much and love from both my both sons.definatly 5 stars deserve.

featured_reviews.review_text: Aparna hospital is a very good down to earth place for maternity. featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Datey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Dr. Aparna enough for being my guiding light during the most difficult phase of my life. She is truly the best gynecologist and a gem of a person.

At 32 weeks of my pregnancy, I suffered from PROM and rushed to her in complete panic, crying inconsolably. Dr. Aparna not only calmed me down but patiently walked me through every step of the process, preparing me for what lay ahead. At that moment, she felt like a godsend — taking me under her wings and ensuring the safety of both me and my baby.

She consulted her entire team, created a thorough plan, and left no stone unturned to prevent complications. What touched me the most was that her sole focus was our well-being, not money. In fact, the topic of payment was only mentioned gently after my surgery.

She wasn’t just my doctor; she became my counselor, my support system. Her hospital radiates warmth and care, making you feel at home in a time of crisis.

In today’s world, where trust in medical care is rare, finding someone like Dr. Aparna feels like meeting a god in human form. I will be forever grateful to her for bringing me and my baby safely through this challenging journey.

featured_reviews.name: Naina Kamerkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am truly grateful to Dr. Samir Prathan for the exceptional care he provided to my daughter throughout her pregnancy. From the beginning, he was supportive, attentive, and professional, ensuring that every step was smooth and stress-free for her.
What stood out the most was his dedication to trying for a normal delivery—he gave it his absolute best, monitoring every detail with precision. However, when the situation changed and he realized that continuing could risk distress for both mother and baby, he made a prompt and wise decision to proceed with an LSCS (C-section). His judgment and timing were spot-on and deeply reassuring to us as a family.
The most remarkable part? Just two days post-surgery, my daughter is walking independently, without support and without significant pain—this speaks volumes about his skill and the quality of care he provides.
Dr. Prathan is not just a brilliant gynecologist, but also a compassionate and trustworthy doctor. We are incredibly thankful to have had him by our side during this important journey. Highly recommended.

Thanks to him, both my baby and I are doing perfectly well. Truly blessed to have been under his care!
